# The tests that .github/scripts/vpntest.ps1 does not run as a smoke test: <name> <reason>, one per line.
#
# Every other test that "vpntest list" prints runs, in every job that calls the script: a new test is a new file with a
# RANZ_TEST line (src/vpntest/testlist.h) and needs no line here. A line names a test that vpntest lists, or the script
# fails. asan-exclude.txt holds what the fuzz-asan job leaves out besides these.
s              the start/stop smoke test, which the script runs first with a check of its own
memory_leak    leaks one byte on purpose
bgp            needs ranz and gobgpd next to vpntest and administrator rights: .github/scripts/bgp-spike.ps1 runs it
evpn           needs ranz next to vpntest, whose sidecars of two nodes peer with each other: .github/scripts/bgp-spike.ps1 runs it
peering        needs ranz next to vpntest and TCP 179 free on 127.0.0.2 to 127.0.0.4: .github/scripts/bgp-peering.ps1 runs it
bgpboth        needs ranz next to vpntest and TCP 179 free on every address: .github/scripts/bgp-peering.ps1 runs it
reflector      needs ranz next to vpntest and TCP 179 free on 127.0.0.2 to 127.0.0.6: .github/scripts/bgp-peering.ps1 runs it
mimic          needs ranz next to vpntest: .github/scripts/mimic-sidecar.ps1 runs it
selfintegrity  needs a signed binary: .github/scripts/self-integrity.ps1 runs it
sdntrace       needs the address and key of a running controller: .github/scripts/sdn-tracer.ps1 runs it
firsttest      needs the address and key of a running controller, administrator rights and wintun.dll next to vpntest: .github/scripts/first-test.ps1 runs it
kmtest         needs administrator rights, a KM-TEST adapter and the drivers of ranz install: the kmtest job runs it (.github/scripts/kmtest.ps1)
nicbridge      needs administrator rights, a KM-TEST adapter, the runner's NIC, the Hyper-V switch of the job and the drivers of ranz install: the kmtest job runs it (.github/scripts/kmtest.ps1)
devicetrace    needs the address and key of a running controller, administrator rights, wintun.dll and wireguard.dll next to vpntest and ranz-wgpeer: .github/scripts/device-tracer.ps1 runs it
listeneracme   needs a test ACME server, ranz next to vpntest and administrator rights: .github/scripts/listener-acme.ps1 runs it
explain        needs the plans that ranz-explainplan writes from the scenarios of tests/explain: .github/scripts/explain-conformance.ps1 runs it
egressnat      changes the NAT of Windows of the runner (its NAT networks of WinNAT), administrator rights and wintun.dll next to vpntest: a step of build_and_test runs it (.github/scripts/egress-nat.ps1)
egressrras     needs a Windows Server whose Routing and Remote Access runs as a LAN router: the egress-rras job installs it and runs the test (.github/scripts/egress-nat.ps1 -Rras)
opstrace       needs the address and key of a running controller whose Intent holds the L2 Network lan: .github/scripts/operations-tracer.ps1 runs it
traytrace      runs until its script stops it, while ranz tray enrols it at a running controller: .github/scripts/tray-tracer.ps1 runs it
